name: clinique-appels
description: Suivi des appels – Clinique des femmes de l'Outaouais (projet SED 2515)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
